_comment: Crimson Battlemage library (plan 20261113-2124, sections 17 to 19). schemaVersion 3: an older copy in the config folder is backed up to .bak and replaced by this file. Four entities: aqtweaks:cultist_battlemage (tier 1), cultist_master_battlemage (tier 2), cultist_swarm_mage and cultist_bombardier_mage (variants). `ai` is the global tuning; each tier and each variant may carry its own `ai` overrides. A tier rolls its loadout from `loadout` (fixed foci, one focus per slot, plus wildcards, within the complexity budget, at most maxHeavy foci at complexity >= heavyComplexity); a variant either carries `fixedLoadout` as is or has its own `loadout`. Equipment entries are an item id or {item, nbt (SNBT), enchantments by registry id}. cooldownTicks null = natural cooldown max(5,(complexity/5)*(complexity/4)).
